label: DEVELOPMENT - not commissioned
rule: The ruler keeps the self-tare's method (a straight line for each probe design from the array's own low and high anchor means) and takes its targets from IAM-Atlas v2.1 instead of reference arrays, so every array lands on the atlas's scale. Anchors, by fixed rules, nothing chosen by hand: sites measured in all 79 cell types, on both the 450K and EPIC v1 chips, on autosomes; LOW = every cell type below 0.10 and outside every CpG island and its 2 kb shores (UCSC hg19 cpgIslandExt), so the islands where early cancer gains are never anchors; HIGH = every cell type above 0.90. Targets: the atlas's mean over each set. Inputs (fetched by the caller into MANIFESTS): HumanMethylation450k_15017482_v3.csv.gz and HumanMethylationEPIC_manifest_v2.csv.gz (array-manifest-files.s3.amazonaws.com), cpgIslandExt.txt.gz (hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu, hg19). Usage: python3 build_atlas_ruler.py MANIFESTS_DIR
